verdict.rationale: Braintrust exposes a broad API (projects, experiments, datasets, prompts, scorers, logging), a CLI, and an MCP server that can query logs, author scorers/prompts, configure monitoring, and run evals—covering most UI functionality programmatically. However, some UI-only features like the no-code Playground for iterative side-by-side comparison, Loop/Patterns AI-driven investigation, and Topics clustering are described primarily as UI experiences without clear API equivalents, and no public OpenAPI spec was found, plus one community review notes limited integration options.
